term: one actual universal ultimate source at a world
definition: UniversalUltimateSourceAt m w y asserts y exists at w and every actually existing x at w satisfies UltimateThroughAt m w x y. UniqueUniversalUltimateSourceAt uses Mathlib ExistsUnique for this same predicate. All targets share this one witness, but no other-world causal scope, necessary existence or uniqueness of all necessary individuals is included.
note: Typed analyst consequence in the same context. Pointwise existence of sources does not license exchanging quantifiers by itself; the separately proved at-most-one condition identifies each local witness. See docs/notes/necessary-simple-plurality.md.
